verdict.rationale: Auth0 has an official, first-party Auth0 CLI. Its docs describe using it to manage tenant configuration, automate tasks, and integrate Auth0 into development and deployment workflows, and the probe confirms the official auth0/auth0-cli GitHub repository. The evidence covers what the CLI is for but not its specific features. Missing for 10: detailed documentation of commands and agent-friendly features (e.g. non-interactive or machine-readable output for AI-native use), and independent or hands-on corroboration of the CLI in practice.
